_documentation: Audit of the Amplify app-level environment variables that on-demand preview builds inherit. See docs/amplify-preview-deployments.md. Every app-level variable must appear in 'inherit' (safe for a preview build) or in 'override' (replaced with a preview-safe value); an unclassified variable stops the deployment before any preview branch is created. Never put a secret in 'override' - this file is public.
